evidence.ref: continuous enter/start/status/stop run; workspace A; 24 edits
evidence.summary: Supervisor RSS 357,788 KiB after entry, 357,976 KiB after 24 changes (+188 KiB), flat for 4 s idle. LS RSS 13,808 KiB after entry, 19,556 KiB after churn, flat during idle. Pending verification=0, queue=0, active job=null, Store projection generation=0.

ABI cache held 1 entry (~2.49 MB under 4 MB); other native caches=0; active process units=0 and retained handles=0 in this no-verifier resident run. The separate ProcessRuntime tests verify caps of 16 active and 128 retained, eviction safety, and foreign/expired fail-closed behavior.

A parent with a child was cancelled through the generic handle; the owned cgroup reached empty, launcher was reaped, and cleanup completed. Tiny fixed memory envelope only; no host-derived allocation.
The language effect-semantics plan still requires repository_canonical_suite_pass. Focused lifecycle evidence is current, but the campaign did not rerun the broad language canonical suite.
The prior-boot journal is unavailable; no cause is attributed to this campaign.

reproduction.instructions: Use the bounded 24-change, 4-second idle resident run and the focused process-runtime cap/tree tests; do not infer host OOM cause or repository-wide suite status from these runs.

summary: A bounded live resident run entered a configured workspace in 8.653 s, processed 24 edit/generation changes, then stayed semantically idle for 4 s. Supervisor RSS was 357,788 KiB after entry and 357,976 KiB after churn (+188 KiB), stable during idle; pending verifications/queue/active job and active/retained process handle counts were zero because no verifier was triggered. Native ABI cache was one ~2.49 MB entry under its 4 MB bound, Store projection generation stayed zero. Separate lifecycle tests prove the 16 active / 128 retained caps and owned-tree cleanup. The historic Fedora low-memory event cause and language effect-semantics repository-canonical RAVEL suite remain UNKNOWN.

workaround.description: Resident verification remains constrained to bounded explicit envelopes and focused evidence until the language canonical suite, full long-lived handle churn, and historic host incident are independently closed.
